scope: N7/N8/N9 evidence audit, not automatic scientific sign-off

criteria.requirement: Fixed-bed lake at rest with slope/curvature combinations
criteria.gap: Satisfied in the named liquid fixtures: smooth, continuous one-cell and fully wet parabolic lakes in 1D/2D, all slope/curvature pairs and supported stage counts. Arbitrary boundaries and variable composition are not silently claimed.

criteria.requirement: No uphill leakage and refinement behavior
criteria.gap: Four-sided Gate-H refinement metrics and 1D one-cell excavation pass with unchanged zero-uphill limits. Reproducible 2D Gate-H full-field comparison remains in N7-D.

criteria.requirement: Reconstruction positivity, compatible mean momentum and velocity bounds
criteria.gap: Liquid production traces, normal/tangential velocities and compatible means agree with reference. Original variable-composition and dynamic near-dry/orientation cases remain in N7-B/N7-C.

criteria.requirement: Smooth, rough and seeded random continuous Q1 beds in 1D and 2D
criteria.gap: Seeded 2D residuals/one-step states and finite-time 1D smooth transport/Ritter trajectories pass. Original finite-time rough 2D, oblique-ramp and circular cases remain in N7-C.

criteria.requirement: Variable-composition transport and signed component conservation
criteria.gap: Local conversion and signed component-flux rescaling pass. Original variable-composition equilibrium/contact and independent component/carrier budgets remain in N7-B.

criteria.requirement: Production semidiscrete residual, CFL and time integration against clean reference
criteria.gap: Directional bounds, covered residuals, supported IMEX order and finite-time 1D fields/raw stages pass. The remaining 2D hierarchy/full-field cases and explicit combined-timestep interpretation remain in N7-C/N7-D/D-N7-CFL. No CFL or retry-policy change is introduced.

criteria.requirement: Mass conservation and symmetry
criteria.gap: Existing total-mass and Gate-H symmetry assertions pass. Original transported-component budgets and circular/orientation symmetry cases remain in N7-B/N7-C; general inlet injection budgets belong to N9.

criteria.requirement: Real one/four-thread equivalence
criteria.gap: Satisfied for the original real one/four-thread regression contract. Newly added mandatory fixtures must follow the same comparison rule; exhaustive future-model/distributed coverage is not a separate prerequisite.

criteria.requirement: Exact deterministic and stochastic continuation
criteria.gap: Satisfied: original-duration deterministic and stochastic restart trajectories pass in both profiles and with actual one/four-thread teams. Do not replace these regressions with shortened runs.

criteria.requirement: Solid availability, substrate inventory and source-mask limits before nodal averaging
criteria.gap: Satisfied: flat single/four-vertex identity, solid/liquid and gas-carrier caps, exhausted reserves, signed gas inflow, conservative/thermal/pore-pressure transactions, cutoff and full/partial source masks pass. Exhaustive rheology/vaporization/entrainment characterization is outside this closure.

criteria.requirement: Mass-lumped global bed-volume identity including dry cells and boundaries
criteria.gap: Satisfied: production uniform-grid volume balance passes across all refinements and seeded updates, including dry contributors/boundaries. User accepts the separately verified unequal-area algebra test; nonuniform production meshes remain unsupported.

criteria.requirement: Exact B_vertex restart with bed evolution
criteria.gap: Satisfied: exact B_vertex/inventory reload, poisoned-cache refresh, nonzero resumed exchange and full evolving-bed continuation pass. Additional physical-model characterization is not a new restart prerequisite.

criteria.requirement: Authoritative nodal bed and refreshed geometry after bed modifications
criteria.gap: Satisfied: independent Q1/LS/Hessian/G checks pass after every seeded 1D/2D update, including retained-state production transactions and all intermediate actual 1/4-thread payloads. The bounded 1D accumulation correction preserves coefficients and OpenMP.

criteria.requirement: Wet/dry local geometric mismatch is diagnosed
criteria.gap: Satisfied: three smooth/wet-dry refinements in both dimensions show decreasing area-L1 mismatch and front localization without dry flow injection. Signed/L1/Linf and rough-stress volume/finite-geometry assertions pass; rough rates have no convergence requirement.

criteria.requirement: HP-PCCU is the sole production backend with canonical state/thermal conventions
criteria.gap: Source inspection supports cutover; acceptance also requires all relevant numerical/model gates and versioned output contracts.

criteria.requirement: Pinned source, tools, compiler flags, inputs, outputs and reference checksums
criteria.gap: Recorded hashes are observations, not approved golden outputs. Clean reference package provenance must be verified separately.

criteria.requirement: Clean strict/debug and optimized validation
criteria.gap: Unit scripts retain their own compilation policy; Froude, mass-exchange, spatial-operator IMEX-stage and N7-A scripts also build strict and optimized production modules. Full production-executable runs exercise both audited profiles. The stage-count contract rejects unsupported N_RK values in both profiles. Passing these tests does not close remaining N7/N8/N9 scientific coverage gaps. M12c automation/portability remains separate.

criteria.requirement: Explicit tolerances and comparator policy
criteria.gap: Use existing per-test limits without relaxing them. Historical KT outputs are not the current production comparator; complete approved tolerance/reference inventory.

criteria.requirement: Long ETNA/lava acceptance and regression ownership
criteria.gap: User reported successful long runs; inputs, executable provenance, quantitative limits and outputs are not pinned in this audit. Long runs must be repeated after the N7-A production corrections before adopting a new optimized scientific baseline.

criteria.requirement: Scientific baseline sign-off
criteria.gap: N9 remains open until failures and required coverage gaps are resolved and baseline approval is explicit.

criteria.requirement: Examples, source inputs, versioned restart and scientific output metadata match canonical semantics
criteria.gap: Local inlet/fissure geometry tests and checkpoint equality do not cover end-to-end fissural injection budgets, decoded NetCDF fields or metadata/schema compatibility.
